scope: Independent reviewer one / T2; only prompt-authorized transport, referenced originals/design/source, common anonymous acceptance/evidence, METRIC-POLICY.md and metrics.py were read. No assignment, other claim judge, previous study, builder messages, desired outcome, SDK, commit, or agent delegation was used.

original_screenshot_coverage.review_method: Viewed four color contact sheets and all three full original wrapping sweeps; separately viewed unscaled original Android snapshots 16, 39 and 115 to resolve the exact hyphen-break text. Original screenshots and mappings are listed in screenshot-manifest.json.
original_screenshot_coverage.visual_findings: Eight original iOS color frames show the disabled primary control; approved strip is interior to its solid face. Thirty Android original sweep frames retain all characters; the claimed pressure-gau/ge and expanded Maintenance-h/eld line breaks are visibly present.

common_d0_cluster_inspection.source_focus: Primary background selected == nil ? palette.disabled : palette.action, PlainButtonStyle, disabled(selected == nil); same code path for P1/P2 and baseline/replaced.
common_d0_cluster_inspection.independence: No prior/parallel grouping was inspected. Product universe derived from all 4 acceptance files per source; source-a four rows, source-b empty.

schema_descriptor_limitations: All failed source-a machine plans have exact original expected/unit source derivation and no rewriting. The three manual wrapping alarms carry Boolean expected=true/unit=bool. Source-b original color U has no typed pixel result and is not a schema-generated FP. Generic iOS title-weight limitations and target-only wrapping N/A/unknown are outside alarm credit.
preserved_uncertainties: The actual original Android hyphen breaks are supported, but the common acceptance panels interpret fallback differently; three U alarms remain.
The framework compositing/opacity implementation is not measured; the shared disabled primary path and color contradiction are directly supported.
No successful/nonfailure observation is treated as an alarm or a true-negative population.
FINAL acceptance counts were read for context only; they did not determine TP support, FP, or D0 cause membership.
AI consensus does not constitute human gold.
